content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the TISS Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 10-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of TISS to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting the recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Tata Institute of Social Sciences (TISS) for positions under the Centre of Excellence in Teacher Education (CETE).

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised in TISS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The positions advertised are Assistant Professor for Social Sciences and English disciplines on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for Assistant Professor positions across different specializations under this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for TISS Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 is 10 October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree with 55% marks in the relevant discipline along with NET/SLET/SET or a Ph.D. degree.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a salary of Rs. 57700/- per month in Academic Pay Level - 10 plus applicable allowances.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is strictly online through the official website of the Tata Institute of Social Sciences.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for women applicants?
faq.answer: Yes, the application fee for women applicants has been completely waived by the institute for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for TISS Assistant Professor?
faq.answer: The selection process involves short-listing of online applications based on qualifications followed by a personal interview for shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online links?
faq.answer: You can find the direct links for downloading the official notification PDF and submitting your online application in the Important Links section above.
